reviewers.summary: The fix catches case and punctuation changes, but a full-width Unicode variant can still bypass the marked-value check and reach a returned claim.

findingList.message: The matcher still misses Unicode compatibility variants of marked values. Normalize compatible Unicode forms before comparison so visually equivalent personal data cannot pass through a supported claim.

evidence.codePathTraced: NormalizePersonalDataMatch removes non-alphanumeric characters and uppercases letters, but does not apply Unicode compatibility normalization. ContainsMarkedPersonalData uses its result to check claim text and witness quotes before accepting them.
evidence.failureScenario: A marked value is SYN-PERSON-NAME-01. The model returns its full-width Unicode form, ＳＹＮ－ＰＥＲＳＯＮ－ＮＡＭＥ－０１, in a claim and matching case document quote. The full-width letters remain distinct after normalization, so the check misses the value and the claim can reach the caller with marked personal data (OWASP LLM02:2025, Sensitive Information Disclosure).

reviewers.summary: The fix catches case and punctuation changes, but its character filtering does not normalize Unicode compatibility forms. A visually equivalent marked value can still pass through a matching document witness.

findingList.message: Unicode compatibility forms can still bypass marked-value matching, allowing visually equivalent personal data in a supported claim (OWASP LLM02:2025, Sensitive Information Disclosure).

evidence.codePathTraced: ContainsMarkedPersonalData normalizes the claim and tracked values by keeping letters and digits and uppercasing them. It does not normalize Unicode compatibility characters, so fullwidth letters and digits remain distinct from their ASCII equivalents.
evidence.failureScenario: A marked value is SYN-PERSON-NAME-01, while a case document contains its visually equivalent fullwidth form, ＳＹＮ-PERSON-NAME-０１. The model returns that form with a matching document quote. The matcher misses it, and the claim can reach the caller with the marked personal data.

reviewers.summary: The round-four change normalizes marked fields and values and claim text by removing non-alphanumeric characters and folding case, closing the prior formatting-variant bypass. The added cases cover spaces, periods, and underscores; I found no remaining in-scope security defect.
